newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China port operator plans 130 mln A share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China port operator plans 130 mln A share IPO.

text.p: Shenzhen Yantian Port Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 130 million A shares on the Shenzhen stock exchange, chief underwriter China Securities said on Monday.
Yantian will use proceeds to build goods piers, warehouses and amenities for its cargo piers, a China Securities official told Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The domestic currency share offer, planned for the first half of 1997, has received China Securities Regulatory Commission's preliminary approval, the official said.
She declined to reveal Yantian's company performance and its outstanding shares.
The issue price has not been fixed.
